newsitem.title: FRANCE: Few heed Eurotunnel strike call, traffic disrupted.
newsitem.headline: Few heed Eurotunnel strike call, traffic disrupted.

text.p: Few workers heeded a strike call at the Franco-British Eurotunnel Channel link on Wednesday but tourist traffic was disrupted by pickets blocking toll-gates, officials said.
Freight traffic and passenger Eurostar trains were not hit by the stoppage, which was expected to last several hours at least.

"Our leaders have told us to put the French trains in the repair area and leave the way clear for the British trains. We're blocking the toll gates," Franck Heranwal, a member of the Communist CGT union, told a rally of several hundred workers.
The unions are demanding better working conditions and have proposed meeting management representatives, who have suggested July 29 for a first round of talks.
